title: The Reclaimers' Offer
summary: Boss Pyke needs a pallet of cutting charges 'rescued' from the cargo winch at the Skydocks and delivered to Aunt Vertex at the Crusher — gently, because technically fireworks. In exchange, the Yards will quote you a price on opening the null crate. A very, very good price. Suspiciously good.

objectives.label: Collect the charges pallet at the cargo winch base
Sign in (next to the burning log) at the yard gate
Deliver the charges to Aunt Vertex at the Crusher

offer.text: Varga! Chief! Opportunity knockin'. A pallet of premium cutting charges 'fell' off a skyship at the winch base and is presently enjoying salvage law, which is our favourite law. Go get it before the Guild counts it.
Bring it to Vertex at the Crusher, nice and smooth. And while you're here — that humming crate of yours? One afternoon on my bench, union rates, and we open it like a birthday. Think it over.

accept.text: Vertex here, duck. Those charges are asleep and I want them to *stay* asleep until services. No hopping, no drifting, no dramatic braking. Pretend you're carrying eggs that yell.

Kid. Before you fall in love with the idea of Pyke opening your crate: the Yards have never once broken anything they were paid to fix, and never once *not* broken anything they were paid to open. Ask them which your crate is.
Charges acquired. They make a little ticking sound. I'm choosing to believe that's a clock.

complete.text: Oh, beautifully ridden, duck — I felt every metre from here and you didn't wake a single one. You'd have made a lovely chaplain. The biscuits are by the door.

Delivery logged, sprout. Now the real business: that crate hums, and on this crew humming means *waking*. A wake-key that old could light half the scar's dead machinery. Open it with us and the Yards stand behind whatever climbs out.
No pressure. Well. Union-standard pressure: the offer expires when the crate does something worse. They always do something worse.

choices.prompt: Pyke's bench is ready. Do you give the Reclaimers your leaning on opening the crate?

options.text: "When it's time to open it, you're the crew with the tools."
"It's sealed cargo, Boss. Sealed stays sealed until it says otherwise."
